dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 王明，这个门是“进”还是“出”？
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, zhège mén shì jìn háishi chū?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Shì chū. Jìn shì nàge mén.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Jìn gōngyuán yào mǎi piào ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 能不能在草地上吃东西？
dialogue.reading: Néng bù néng zài cǎodì shang chī dōngxi?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Néng! Wǒmen qù nàlǐ chī ba.
